1936, October
FATHER SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 6.
Page 146 Cont.
Oct. 12 Marg. Burns - 38 - intestinal trouble - has lost two babies - mis ... Mrs. Cath. Carroll - 42 - Gall stones in Rochester Minn, operation last Saturday.
13 Rose Majeski - 70 - veric ... Veins & itch. Mrs. Sales - husband in bad company
14 Frank Vercanmer - 24 - threatened with T.B. .. . hospital To-day ... Mrs. Helen Selter - operated on this a.m. very peculiar tuomer ... !!!
Page 147
Oct. 14 Henrietta Haire - 5 - lost sight in one eye through accident at birth.
Louis Caza - 65 - cancer in mouth & rhumatism. Has wife and four daughters
Wm. Allwein - 64 of Lebanon, Pa. - cancer of stomach. Mrs. Cath. Koenkberger - this a.m. in Chicago
20 Mildred Kappler - 34 - Thanksgiving for complete restoration was in Sanitarium ( St. Joseph Retreat) seemingly hopeless - donation alms $15.
20 Margaret Trimble - 15 - streptoctis poison in blood. Dr. after Dr. has pronounced her hopeless: was anointed ten days ago - then not expected to live till morning .... Father married out of the Church when mother was 4 yrs +.
Mrs. Irene Miller - 52 - Arthritis for 17 yrs. - 3 yrs. convert .. Ronald Emerick - 13 mo. - Very poorly but improving ....
Page 148 Oct. 21 Xav. Fish - 28 - Kidney - stomach - indigestion
1936, November
Nov. 3rd Br. Leo Casey - 59 .... + Mrs. Lizette (Leo) Reilly ....
